items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jimmy Dorsey had been there and had established himself. Now Benny came along and unseated him. I had to come along and unseat both of them or at least elbow them aside.

ctx.x: You were also recording a lot of good music at that time.

Not much. Very little. There were a few decent jazz records being made, where at least you could try. But see I had a problem when I got to New York. Jimmy Dorsey had been there and had established himself. Now Benny came along and unseated him. I had to come along and unseat both of them or at least elbow them aside. I was the new kid on the block.
Was there only room for one?
